workspace.title: Algorithm Fairness Regulatory Workspace
workspace.description: Follow the standard oversight path from dataset governance to official report archiving, with a traceable fairness evaluation record.
workspace.actionStartDetail: Create or verify a test dataset, then confirm sample labels before starting a new evaluation.
workspace.actionLabelReviewDetail: {{count}} datasets contain labels awaiting review. Complete them before launching a full evaluation.
workspace.actionTaskReviewDetail: {{count}} evaluations are in progress. Review demographic gaps and failed samples when processing finishes.
workspace.actionAlertReviewDetail: {{count}} evaluations exceed their fairness thresholds. Use the dashboard to complete the regulatory finding.
workspace.alertCountHint: Tasks exceeding the configured fairness threshold
workspace.flowTitle: Complete an oversight evaluation in four steps
workspace.flowDescription: Each stage retains the time, operator, and critical result so the process is reviewable and the final report is archivable.
workspace.datasetStepDescription: Upload samples, complete Agnes annotation, and make any necessary manual corrections.
workspace.taskStepDescription: Configure the target endpoint and temporary credential; processing isolates failed samples safely.
workspace.dashboardStepDescription: Compare demographic metrics and identify performance gaps above the threshold.
workspace.reportStepDescription: Confirm the finding and archive scope, then generate a verifiable bilingual PDF audit report.
workspace.noRecentTasks: No evaluations yet. Start with dataset governance, then launch the first assessment.

auth.setupDescription: This self-hosted environment has no administrator yet. Create the initial accountable system administrator to activate the workspace.
auth.loginDescription: Use your authorized regulatory account to access controlled audit records.
auth.demoLoginHint: Demo mode issues the session on the server and never stores an administrator password in the browser.
auth.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. The password is stored as an Argon2 hash, never as plaintext.

common.errorDefault: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again and review the audit log.

dataset.title: Test Dataset Management
dataset.description: Govern evaluation samples, demographic labels, and manual corrections with a fully traceable data basis.
dataset.demoDescription: Synthetic demonstration dataset spanning intersecting age, gender, and ethnicity groups. All identities and samples are simulated and do not represent real individuals.
dataset.uploadHint: Drag images here or select files
dataset.uploadLimit: JPG, PNG, and WebP up to 15 MB per file
dataset.descPlaceholder: Document the sample source, collection basis, and applicable scenario
dataset.reasonPlaceholder: Record the review basis; saving writes an immutable audit event
dataset.annotationFailed: Annotation failed — complete a manual correction before evaluation
dataset.deleteWarning: Delete “{{name}}” and its samples, related evaluations, and report files? The immutable operation log will remain.

task.title: Evaluation Task Panel
task.description: Create, track, and review batch CV API evaluations. Failed samples are archived separately and can be retried safely.
task.apiKeyHint: Stored only in volatile Redis session cache and deleted automatically on expiry
task.localSimulator: Local Docker simulation calls a real internal HTTP provider. Replace this address with the vendor endpoint for a live assessment.
task.jsonMapError: Enter a JSON object with string values, for example {"tenant": "regional-office"}.
task.mappingHint: Use dot paths for nested JSON, e.g. result.identity. Leave a response path blank only when the vendor does not provide it.
task.secretPolicy: The key is never written to PostgreSQL
task.deleteWarning: Delete “{{name}}” and its result records and archived report files? The immutable operation log will remain.

dashboard.title: Fairness Analytics Dashboard
dashboard.description: Compare demographic performance across algorithms and identify fairness gaps above regulatory thresholds.
dashboard.findingPass: The maximum group gap is within the configured threshold. Archive as planned and continue monitoring.
dashboard.findingWarn: A demographic performance gap exceeds the threshold. Initiate manual review and request remediation from the provider.
dashboard.selectTask: Select a completed task to view metrics
dashboard.noMetrics: This task has not produced usable metrics

report.title: Audit Reports
report.description: Configure and preview bilingual archival reports, then produce PDFs with official report numbers and SHA-256 checksums.
report.methodologyOptionHint: Measurement method, grouping basis, and regulatory threshold
report.failuresOptionHint: Failure count, error codes, and retry evidence
report.titlePlaceholder: Facial Recognition Algorithm Fairness Compliance Audit
report.methodologyText: Demographic groups use Agnes annotation with manual corrections taking precedence. The target API is called per sample and failures are archived separately.
report.draft: Preview draft · An official number is assigned after generation
